verify: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && uv run pytest
note: Marker that flags this as a T4 repo — the hooks fire only when this file is present, so they never touch a non-T4 repo. Set "verify" to a FAST test command (unit+build+lint; leave e2e to CI) to arm the local ship gate: t4-gate RUNS it before `gh pr merge` and blocks on failure. Empty = off; keep it in sync with .github/workflows/t4-verify.yml. Set "requireGreenCI" true to also block `gh pr merge` while any server-side check is failing or still pending (`gh pr checks`) — the fallback for repos that can't make checks required in branch protection; see references/ci-cd-layer.md. Set "autoMerge" (or "afk") true during an unattended run so `gh pr merge` doesn't stop to ask for review confirmation — the verify and CI denies still apply. "afk": true additionally lets the gate permit `git reset --hard`/`git clean` for reverting a parked item to green (force-push and `branch -D` stay blocked).
opencodeNote: Repo-local, read by .claude/hooks/orionfx-opencode-merge-gate (issue #149), not by the vendored t4-gate. The gate is on if "requireOpenCodeReview" is true here OR in the default branch's copy (read with gh api; its settings win). "requireOpenCodeReview": true accepts only `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <head>` and requires the latest review by "opencodeBotLogin" at the head to end `Verdict: 0 blocker, 0 major`, with every bot thread (any round) resolved and answered or outdated; a PR touching "riskPaths" (globs: ** spans directories, * stays within one) also needs a trusted <!-- t4:independent-review head=<sha> --> comment; with no OpenCode review at the head, only an explicit <!-- t4:opencode-fallback head=<sha> reason="..." --> plus the independent-review record lets it merge. Past "opencodeMaxRounds" OpenCode reviews (one per distinct commit) the block says stop and ask the owner. Procedure: docs/agents/workflow.md -> Review gates. PR #144 (the OpenCode workflows) is on main (e885f0e); kept false in PR #150 and set to true in a follow-up after it merges. The "same finding 3 times -> stop" rule is procedure; the hook does not detect repeats.
